svg.title: What a Runtime is made of
svg.desc: A resolved Runtime is one execution composition: a Model / Provider Adapter (identity, catalog, protocol, usage), a provider-neutral Harness Core (turn and step loop, tool dispatch, events, cancel, resume), Harness Capabilities admitted by policy and by what the adapter supports, and a Runtime Profile that binds model, effort, capability set and environment. It executes in an Environment — files, process, network, permission boundary — which today is a local working directory, not a trusted sandbox. The Harness Core keeps runtime protocol state, runtime-scoped; the execution owner is obliged to keep it recoverable, and that fidelity is not yet proven (DRT-02). It is not memory and not the Matter. Matter state lives in the Work Core, outside this chain; candidates reach it through the extension work adapter, while run events and telemetry go to the host runtime store. Today the composition is Pi AgentSession plus configuration and the service still calls its session manager directly; the target is to replace the composition and keep the Matter.
svg.text: RESOLVED RUNTIME · ONE EXECUTION COMPOSITION · PI AGENTSESSION + CONFIGURATION TODAY
